subject: Running generated quantities block on its own

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: Running generated quantities block on its own
parts:
I'm looking forward to once the Stan refactor is done, then we should be able to run a generated quantities block on its own? This would be great. Right now I'm often generating random variables in R, and it's a mess. It will be wonderful to just be able to do it in Stan. It's the next step toward real probablilistic programming.
A

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Running generated quantities block on its own
parts:
Just some terminology. Refactoring doesn't add functionality.
It just sets the software up so it's easier to modify and maintain
in the future. With full round-trip I/O, this and initializing
mass matrices should be much easier.

We have quite a few features that have been put on hold until
after the refactor and we'll have to prioritize them.

- Bob
